items.title: Zero Data Retention (ZDR): What It Means for AI APIs — OpenRouter Blog
items.summary: 这篇内容聚焦「AI 技术演进和可复用工程实践」。原文摘要显示：Zero Data Retention means an AI provider doesn't store your prompts or responses after inference. Learn what ZDR covers, what it excludes, and how to enforce it on OpenRouter.
items.insightText: 先快速判断它是否包含可复用方法、架构或工程经验，再决定是否进入日报深读。
